visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white bicolored cat lies on its back inside a light-colored, oval-shaped corrugated cardboard scratching bowl. The cat's belly is exposed, and its paws are curled up. The background features a wooden floor and a white multi-level cat toy. (2) The cat turns its head slightly towards the camera, looking up with wide, curious eyes. Its pink paw pads are clearly visible. A white translucent curtain is seen on the left edge of the frame. (3) The cat remains in its supine position, looking off-camera to the left. Its tail, with orange and white rings, lies across the floor and flicks slightly. (4) The cat blinks and stares intently at something out of frame. The indoor lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows on the wooden planks. (5) The cat stays perfectly still in its relaxed pose, belly up, as if observing the person filming it. (6) The cat continues to lie in the scratcher, eyes wide and fixed. The camera is static at a slightly high angle, capturing the cat's full body and the surrounding home environment.
